race.comment: CINQUE STELLE (13) was heavily backed last start but was run off her feet early staying at 1200m, though she flashed late once she sorted things out. Up to 1400m now is a big tick and she's much better than she showed last start. Can bounce back in a big way third-up despite the outside barrier. LADIES PRO (1) resumed with a bang over 1200m and should be better again for that run and a rise in distance. Drawn wider this time, but she now gets Shinn on board and she looks set to raise the bar once again. LIKE CLOCKWORK (11) couldn't match CINQUE STELLE two back but stuck on well in the Peters a fortnight ago over 1500m. An inside draw today is a big positive with Parnham taking over. Can make her presence felt. DRAKAINA (5) was 1.3L off LADIES PRO last start but she was only first-up there. Can improve out in trip and with the added fitness. IN CONFIDENCE (12) is unbeaten third-up and looks to get every chance getting out to 1400m.
